notes.title: Curve Games Spring Sale is here!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33019968/sale/springsale2023][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29825757/7fca6a684ffb18a81f871782dc03a314e75afaac.png[/img][/url]

Spring is in the air, and so is the excitement of our amazing Spring Sale at Curve Games! The season of renewal and growth has arrived, and what better way to celebrate than by indulging in some incredible game deals? 

Whether you're looking for some new games to play or want to revisit some old favorites, our Spring Sale has got you covered. Enjoy a great discount on all titles in our catalog, including popular games like For The King, The Ascent, From Space, and Patch Quest. 

Don't wait too long, though - these deals will last until the 23rd! 

[h1]Patch Quest[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1347970/Patch_Quest/

Get into the action with Patch Quest! Explore the vibrant and dangerous world of Patchlantis, inspired by roguelikes, Metroidvania, and monster-taming games. Collect rare monsters and uncover the island's secrets. For a limited time, get 25% off and join the adventure now! 

[h1]Blooming Business Casino Demo [/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388580/

Step back in time and build the ultimate retro casino in the bustling era of 1950s Las Venas with Retro Casino Tycoon. Want to play upstanding citizen simulator? uhhh.... maybe you should skip Blooming Business: Casino, where you need to keep it friendly with the local mafia…  

Expand your casino and unlock new features as you gain income and reputation. But remember to keep your staff and guests satisfied to ensure your casino's success. Balance your financial goals with guest satisfaction to become the ultimate Casino Tycoon in Las Venas! 

Wishlist now and enjoy the Blooming Business: Casino demo!  

[h1]For The King II  [/h1]

While you are playing For The King, don’t forget to wishlist For The King 2 and get ready to Join fellow renegades in a fight against her fanatical Queensguard to save your village and realm.  

Gather your courage and take on the challenge. For The King! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676840/

[h1]Human: Fall Flat  [/h1]

Don’t miss the latest Human: Fall Flat level inspired by the versatile chemical element Copper!  

In Copper World, you'll explore an industrialized zone filled with gigantic wheels, electric circuits, and massive coal engines that unlock unique paths and points of intrigue. This challenging level promises to be one of the most exciting yet in Human: Fall Flat. 

Grab your friends and get ready to maximize the fun in this comical Copper World quest! 

Don’t miss the Curve bundles selection. Take advantage of this Sale, save money, and enjoy the spring season by adding some terrific games to your collection! 
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/477160/
